queries.description: One query per capability: service + action + object keywords (e.g. ['gmail send email', 'github create issue']), never a question; every word must match tool text. Searched in parallel.

function.name: tool_describe
function.description: Load the full JSON schemas for tools returned by `tool_search`. Required before `tool_call` if a tool's parameters are unknown. Batch every schema you need into one call.

names.description: Exact tool names (as returned by tool_search). A single string is accepted and treated as one name.

function.name: tool_call
function.description: Invoke deferred tools: `calls` is an array of {name, arguments}, one entry per invocation (batch independent calls; results come back in order). Arguments match the schema from `tool_describe`; approvals and hooks apply as usual.

calls.description: One or more independent deferred tool invocations.
